poi_fuengirola_bioparc.short_tip: Allow half a day. Most of the route is shaded.

snakeroom.name: Snakeroom Serpentarium
snakeroom.description: An education centre with snakes, reptiles, amphibians and insects from around the world. Visits are guided and you can touch some of the animals.
snakeroom.short_tip: One-hour guided visit in small groups. Closed on Mondays.

finca-secretario.name: Finca del Secretario Roman Site
finca-secretario.description: Remains of a 1st-century Roman villa with pottery kilns, baths and fish-salting tanks, where the famous Venus of Fuengirola was found.
finca-secretario.short_tip: Free access. A short visit, with panels explaining each room.

termas-torreblanca.name: Torreblanca Roman Baths
termas-torreblanca.description: A seaside site with Roman baths and a late-antique necropolis, protected under a roof with walkways.
termas-torreblanca.short_tip: Limited opening hours: check before you go.

museo-ciudad.name: City Museum
museo-ciudad.description: A small local history museum, from the first settlers to Roman and Moorish times, with finds from Finca del Secretario and Sohail Castle.
museo-ciudad.short_tip: Free entry. Open in the mornings.

mercadillo.name: Fuengirola Market
mercadillo.description: One of the biggest street markets on the Costa del Sol: every Tuesday, hundreds of stalls with clothes, crafts, fruit and antiques at the fairground.
mercadillo.short_tip: Tuesday mornings only. Go early: by midday it's packed.
